lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: All right. And you're telling me that when you told Mark that you didn't see it, is that when you were startin to think about what people told you to say and thinking about that type of stuff?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. I can understand that. Are you now on, on the same page as us? Trying to help Teresa?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And to help yourself. Because like you said the worst is over. You, you've never, you've never wavered on the fact that you helped Steven do this, and, and that's the truth. OK. It's just some of those little details that, that had to be ironed out. When you saw Teresa in the house and up until she went to the garage, was she, did you ever see her bleeding? In the house?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did anyone ever hit her or hurt her that you saw, in the house?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What about any, injuries to Steven? Again, the Halbachs are what matter here. Did Steven hurt himself?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well there was a scratch on his finger.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: When did you first notice that scratch bleeding?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: When I was over there the first time.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Did Steven ever tell you how he got her tied up back there? How did he do that?
